WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::TEXT action,NULLIF($2::BIGINT,0) clinic_id,NULLIF($3::TEXT,'') clinic_name,
         $4::TEXT timezone,NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') address_text,NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') phone,
         NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') email,NULLIF($8::TEXT,'') description,$9::JSONB metadata,
         NULLIF($10::TEXT,'') actor_name,$11::TEXT source_channel,$12::INTEGER result_limit
),
target AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM clinics c,r
  WHERE (r.clinic_id IS NOT NULL AND c.id=r.clinic_id)
     OR (r.clinic_id IS NULL AND r.clinic_name IS NOT NULL AND c.name=r.clinic_name)
  ORDER BY c.id
  LIMIT 1
),
inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO clinics(name,timezone,is_active,address_text,phone,email,description,metadata,updated_at)
  SELECT r.clinic_name,r.timezone,TRUE,r.address_text,r.phone,r.email,r.description,r.metadata,NOW()
  FROM r
  WHERE r.action='create'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target)
  RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE clinics c
  SET name=CASE WHEN r.action='update' AND r.clinic_name IS NOT NULL THEN r.clinic_name ELSE c.name END,
      timezone=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN r.timezone ELSE c.timezone END,
      address_text=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN COALESCE(r.address_text,c.address_text) ELSE c.address_text END,
      phone=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN COALESCE(r.phone,c.phone) ELSE c.phone END,
      email=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN COALESCE(r.email,c.email) ELSE c.email END,
      description=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN COALESCE(r.description,c.description) ELSE c.description END,
      metadata=CASE WHEN r.action='update' THEN c.metadata||r.metadata ELSE c.metadata END,
      is_active=CASE WHEN r.action='activate' THEN TRUE WHEN r.action='deactivate' THEN FALSE ELSE c.is_active END,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM r
  WHERE c.id=(SELECT id FROM target)
    AND r.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate')
  RETURNING c.*
),
effective AS (
  SELECT inserted.* FROM inserted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT updated.* FROM updated
  UNION ALL
  SELECT target.* FROM target,r
  WHERE r.action='get'
  LIMIT 1
),
admin_event AS (
  INSERT INTO clinic_admin_events(
    clinic_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,actor_name,source_channel,before_data,after_data
  )
  SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT id FROM effective),(SELECT id FROM target)),
    'clinic',
    COALESCE((SELECT id FROM effective),(SELECT id FROM target)),
    r.action,
    r.actor_name,
    r.source_channel,
    COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(target) FROM target),'{}'::JSONB),
    COALESCE((SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective),'{}'::JSONB)
  FROM r
  WHERE r.action IN ('create','update','activate','deactivate')
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM effective)
  RETURNING id
),
listed AS (
  SELECT c.id,c.name,c.timezone,c.is_active,c.address_text,c.phone,c.email,
         c.description,c.metadata,c.created_at,c.updated_at
  FROM clinics c,r
  WHERE r.action='list'
  ORDER BY c.id
  LIMIT (SELECT result_limit FROM r)
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN r.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN FALSE
       WHEN r.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN FALSE
       ELSE TRUE END success,
  CASE WHEN r.action='create' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'clinic_already_exists'
       WHEN r.action IN ('update','activate','deactivate','get') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN 'clinic_not_found'
       WHEN r.action='create' THEN 'clinic_created'
       WHEN r.action='update' THEN 'clinic_updated'
       WHEN r.action='activate' THEN 'clinic_activated'
       WHEN r.action='deactivate' THEN 'clinic_deactivated'
       WHEN r.action='get' THEN 'clinic_loaded'
       ELSE 'clinics_listed' END result,
  (SELECT TO_JSONB(effective) FROM effective) clinic,
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(listed)) FROM listed),'[]'::JSONB) clinics,
  (SELECT id FROM admin_event) admin_event_id
FROM r;

## مدیریت کلینیک

اقدام‌ها: create, update, activate, deactivate, get, list

تمام تغییرات در clinic_admin_events ثبت می‌شوند.
